label: Prometheus telemetry connector
summary: Prepare scoped metric publication or federation references with bounded cardinality and local monitoring continuity.
core_boundary: Mandatory local alerts and audit stay in Core; optional metrics export does not grant broad host discovery or disclose tenant labels. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Select one reviewed collection/export mode and map only approved resource labels and metric families.
Test tenant filtering, endpoint admission, credential rotation and bounded sample/cardinality budgets.
Exercise destination outage and backpressure without blocking hosting or mandatory local evidence.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
